title: Dissection of the sample email
author: 64cf7168c6edd65797781320
chapter_outcomes: Students will be able to construct an email response within the 120-160 word limit.
Students will be able to structure an email into distinct paragraphs that address three specific bullet points in the given order.
Students will be able to compose a brief opening paragraph to personalize the email and connect to the recipient.
Students will be able to interpret command words such as "describe," "explain," and "say" to appropriately determine the length and depth of each paragraph.
Students will be able to apply figurative language to enhance the descriptive quality of their writing.
Students will be able to formulate appropriate informal greetings and friendly farewells for email correspondence.
Students will be able to develop and maintain an informal tone suitable for writing to a friend.
Students will be able to construct a logical flow between paragraphs to ensure the email reads cohesively.
